name: capture-team
description: THINK School AI Capture Team helps practitioners discover opportunities worth pursuing, qualify and prioritize them against organizational criteria, and turn the resulting intelligence into decision-ready Capture Briefs. Three Digital Employees work together: Chet discovers, Kipp qualifies and prioritizes, and Ben develops capture intelligence and pursuit recommendations.

interface.shortDescription: Find the right opportunities, assess fit, and focus on what is worth pursuing.
interface.longDescription: An AI Capture Team of specialized Digital Employees that helps practitioners identify opportunities, assess fit against organizational criteria, prioritize where to spend limited pursuit capacity, and turn the resulting intelligence into decision-ready Capture Briefs. Use it across government contracting, grants and funding, or business development workflows. Bring your own organizational criteria, CRM, enrichment tools, opportunity sources, and document storage. Nothing is pre-wired to a specific vendor. Chet discovers, Kipp qualifies and prioritizes, and Ben turns the result into a decision-ready brief. Want to build, customize, and manage AI Teams for your own workflows? THINK School on Skool teaches you how.
defaultPrompt: Find grant opportunities for my organization
